name: Harbourlight Dinner for Two
shortDescription: A refined couple's evening with a coastal menu, candlelit pacing, and a quiet view toward the harbour.
longDescription: Harbourlight Dinner for Two is an imagined premium evening at the fictional Harbour & Pine in Auckland. The experience pairs a seasonal coastal menu with thoughtful pacing, an intimate table, and time to enjoy the harbour mood together.
imageAlt: An elegant, warmly lit dining room illustrating this fictional couple dinner concept
